title: Modeled backlog during one partition overload
method: Synthetic arrival 1,200 records/s minus processing 1,000/s gives 200/s backlog growth. At 60 s backlog=12,000; at 300 s=60,000. Recovery at 1,500/s leaves 300/s net drain and takes 200 s. Constant rates and no data loss assumed.
alt: Modeled backlog during one partition overload. Start: 0 records; After 1 minute: 12000 records; After 5 minutes: 60000 records. Illustrative values.
